title: osmoxylon zippelianum

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
